description: PAR-FOLD and SQL-AGG-ORDER, missing variant: the same many-group reads over FGI, whose index on g was built before the insert (earlier: all 4096 groups summed 0). Asks the GROUP BY with First/Last and one GetRows, the sums grouped by value, the single-group reads for g = 1, 151, 1000 and 4096 with their scan-order ids, and the first 40 ids of the table. Follow-up probe (round 2) for PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-ORDER; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q2-expr-sql-fold through DAO.DBEngine.120. Each DAO statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
